old_description: AC Delco, Motorcraft, Mopar, Bosch, Denso, NGK, Aisin, Advics, Lucas Oil Products, Castro Edge, Grote, Rhino Pac, Westar, Walker, Maval, AMS Automotive, Hayden Automotive, classic Volkswagon parts and accessories, and so much more.
about:
Maui Auto Parts operates from Wailuku, Hawaii, tracing its origins to 1989 when Aloha Otto Parts opened on Dairy Road in Kahului. In 2011 the business merged with Pacific Jobbers Warehouse on Oahu and adopted the Maui Auto Parts name. Today it is the only employee‑owned auto parts company in Maui and the state of Hawaii.

The company distributes original‑equipment and name‑brand auto parts across categories including ignition, fuel, electrical, braking, steering, drivetrain, engine, and fluid systems, plus a specialty line of classic Volkswagen components. Its Wailuku warehouse stocks roughly 86,000 line items on Maui, with an additional 500,000 parts available from its Oahu facility and access to millions more from mainland suppliers. Maui Auto Parts also runs a commercial e‑commerce platform that integrates with shop management systems such as Mitchell 1, offering VIN and plate‑to‑VIN lookups, order history, and inventory visibility.

Primary customers are professional repair shops, fleet operators, and independent technicians throughout Wailuku, Kahului, Kihei, Lahaina, and Up Country Maui. The business also serves retail walk‑in customers and classic Volkswagen enthusiasts. Free same‑day or next‑day delivery is provided to commercial accounts across its service area.

The employee‑ownership structure is cited as a key differentiator, aligning staff incentives with customer service. The company emphasizes knowledgeable counter specialists, a broad brand portfolio from AC Delco, Motorcraft, Bosch, Denso, and others, and a willingness to source hard‑to‑find parts from its extended network.
